input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates. Customer shall give prompt written notice, and the assignee shall assume the applicable obligations.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full: 24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only); 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on Customer's change of control. Section 13.3 reinforces this by allowing transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 assignment. No change-of-control or assignment restriction operates against us, so no redline is warranted.
